artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan closing S4 decidability via the completeness half for the ordered keyed driver modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered, superseding the obsolete Phase 7 of plan 01.

memory_candidates.content: When a formal-verification task is blocked because a proof was built against a driver/implementation nothing actually runs, the durable fix is often not to reconcile the two but to check whether a THIRD artifact landed while the task sat blocked -- a new implementation whose internals are the ones the existing proof is already about. Re-verify a recorded blocker clause-by-clause against HEAD before re-planning: in this subsystem, two of three blocker clauses stayed literally true while ceasing to be relevant, because the consumer they referenced was superseded. Corollary for planning: pair soundness and completeness against the SAME concrete driver, and make the decidability capstone depend on both halves of that one driver -- the prior plan blocked precisely because that pairing was implicit rather than a phase dependency.
